description: `ui-health search query "<text>"` returns ranked UI-surface results (components, pages, features, hooks) across all adopting scenarios in AI mode, with `ComponentProvenance` fields (CUSTOM / ADOPTED_UNMODIFIED / ADOPTED_MODIFIED / UNKNOWN), library, library_version, source_sha256, and drift_hash where applicable; `--mode text` falls back to substring matching when Ollama or Qdrant is unavailable.

requirements.description: The CLI command `ui-health search query "<text>"` must return ranked UI-surface results (components, pages, features, hooks) across all adopting scenarios. In AI mode (default), results are ranked via Qdrant vector similarity using embeddings from the Ollama `embedding.default` role. Each result must include ComponentProvenance fields: adoption status (CUSTOM / ADOPTED_UNMODIFIED / ADOPTED_MODIFIED / UNKNOWN), library, library_version, source_sha256, and drift_hash. When `--mode text` is specified, or when Ollama or Qdrant is unavailable, the command falls back to substring matching.
requirements.title: Semantic UI-Surface Search with AI and Text Fallback
